items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Red Elkins(?) knew him, and said 'Red, what did you think of Lester?'

ctx.x: Yeah. Red was with Fletcher Henderson. Lester wasn't with us then. We'd just left him in Kansas City.

items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: King said he used to be comin' down, Red's father did -- [SINGS] He'd be shakin' his head.

ctx.x: He didn't shake the fingers or the lip. He'd shake... King said he used to be comin' down, Red's father did -- [SINGS] He'd be shakin' his head.
Anybody else that he ever commented on?
